einzeiler: A collection of listener-submitted true horror and scary personal encounter stories.
kurzfassung: This episode features various unsettling personal accounts sent in by listeners. The stories cover frightening encounters during childhood, at home, and in public spaces. Narrated experiences include strange intruders, threatening strangers, and dangerous situations.
stichpunkte: An encounter with a stranger who stumbled into a flat
A scary incident that occurred in Wisconsin
An experience involving a murderer in an adjacent car
A threatening encounter involving a guy with a knife at school
An unsettling experience while being home alone
An encounter with a late night visitor
An experience involving a couch creeper
